title: Perf lab: expand GPU coverage to H200 + L40S for FP8/INT8 benchmark matrix
creator: Talia Benson
description:
Goal
Add H200 + L40S coverage in perf-lab so the FP8/INT8 sprint matrix can run on (A100, H100/H200, L40S) with reproducible environments and minimal run-to-run noise.

Context
The FP8/INT8 benchmarking sprint needs end-to-end and microbench results across the primary fleet SKUs. We currently have stable A100 + H100 coverage; H200 and L40S are missing/partial and are blocking the “full matrix” run.

Links
- Umbrella: ENG-24810 (FP8/INT8 kernel benchmarking sprint)
- Environment pinning: ENG-24812
- Internal provisioning/support: INT-842 (perf-lab capacity + isolation)
- Confluence (GPU plan/assumptions): sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/benchmarking-and-perf-suite/gpu-matrix-and-perf-lab-assumptions.json
- Drive (H200 provisioning plan): sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/infrastructure/perf-lab-h200-provisioning-plan.json
- Runbook: sources/confluence/eng-serving-runtime/benchmarking-and-perf-suite/runbook-running-benchmarks-in-benchmark-lab.json

Deliverables / Acceptance criteria
1) H200 nodes available in perf-lab
- At least 2 H200 nodes schedulable by benchmark-lab runner.
- Driver/CUDA versions match the pinned environment from ENG-24812 (or an explicit exception documented).
- GPU persistence mode enabled; clocks/power settings documented in the runbook.
- Verify no MIG mode unless explicitly required; if enabled, document partition sizes and impact on metrics.

2) L40S nodes available in perf-lab
- At least 2 L40S nodes schedulable by benchmark-lab runner.
- Confirm stable FP8/INT8 execution for the sprint’s top hosted models (no intermittent correctness failures).
- Document any GPU-conditional disables/known quirks (e.g., fused op disable, kernel family constraints) in gpu-matrix-and-perf-lab-assumptions.

3) Benchmark harness + canary integration readiness
- benchmark-lab can target gpu_sku={H200,L40S} via config without manual node selection.
- perf-canary job selection updated (or follow-up filed) so nightly quant-perf includes at least one H200 and one L40S run once capacity is stable.

4) Reliability / noise controls
- Nodes are isolated from background jobs that skew perf (or isolation is documented + compensated for).
- Baseline noise measured: run a small smoke workload 10x and record coefficient of variation for TTFT/TPOT + tokens/sec.

Out of scope
- Broad cluster scheduler changes beyond what’s needed to secure dedicated capacity for perf runs.
- Enabling MI300X coverage (nice-to-have; separate ticket if we decide to pursue).

Implementation plan (high level)
- Provisioning (SRE/Infra)
  - Confirm quotas and reservation for H200 and L40S.
  - Ensure images support pinned drivers/CUDA; bake AMI/container runtime changes if required.
  - Apply taints/labels so benchmark-lab runner can target SKUs deterministically.
  - Configure isolation window(s) for long benchmark runs.

- Validation (Runtime perf owners)
  - Run a short “hello” suite on each new SKU: 1 microbench + 1 end-to-end streaming scenario.
  - Capture clocks, power, ECC, throttling indicators.
  - File follow-ups for any kernel correctness/perf anomalies.

Blockers / Dependencies
- INT-842: need dedicated perf-lab capacity and reduced contention.
- ENG-24812: environment pinning must land (or we risk mixing driver/CUDA/container versions and invalidating comparisons).

Risks / Notes
- L40S has historically been more sensitive to certain fused ops / kernel variants; we should validate correctness early and be ready to GPU-conditionally disable unstable paths.
- H200 results must be reported separately from H100 unless we have a clear equivalency statement; otherwise we risk conflating improvements with hardware differences.

Progress updates
- 2025-10-01 (Sean Gallagher): Filed request in INT-842 for 2x H200 + 2x L40S nodes with reservation windows for benchmark runs. Waiting on infra quota confirmation.
- 2025-10-03 (Rina Kobayashi): benchmark-lab runner supports GPU SKU tags, but we need consistent node labels (gpu_sku=h200 / gpu_sku=l40s). Please align naming with existing a100/h100 labels to avoid config drift.
- 2025-10-04 (Allison Grant): Once SKUs are stable, we’ll add dashboard breakdowns by gpu_sku. Please ensure metadata tags emitted by benchmark-lab include sku + driver + cuda.
- 2025-10-07 (Sean Gallagher): H200 nodes provisioned but not yet in the perf-lab pool; infra is still finalizing image + driver pin. L40S nodes available but seeing intermittent job preemption due to contention (ties back to INT-842).
- 2025-10-09 (Noah Patel): We should not run the full matrix on L40S until contention is resolved; the noise will drown small kernel deltas. Suggest: gate matrix start on dedicated reservation window.

Next steps
- Sean: confirm final node labels/taints, and reservation window for uninterrupted runs (per INT-842).
- Rina/Noah: run SKU smoke suite (10x repetition) and record baseline noise; report in sprint working doc.
- If provisioning slips >48h: propose contingency plan (re-scope matrix to H200 only + limited L40S spot checks) and document in sprint report.
